authority: Owner-directed free-tier assessment policy derived from the accepted responsibility/access crosswalk and learner graph roles.

policy_values.ASSESSMENT_REQUIRED: A scored knowledge/boundary check is required for course completion. Minimum five normalized questions unless a stricter course-specific standard applies.
policy_values.KNOWLEDGE_CHECK_OPTIONAL: A knowledge check may reinforce learning, but absence of a scored quiz is not a release defect.
policy_values.PRACTICE_OBSERVATION_MORE_APPROPRIATE: Knowledge checks may be present, but practical competence is represented by bounded observed practice rather than quiz performance.
policy_values.REFERENCE_NO_ASSESSMENT: Public reference material does not require scored completion; self-checks may exist without becoming access/completion gates.

invariant: No assessment result may imply physical competence, certification, licensure, qualification, appointment, or employer/jobsite authorization.

enforcement.note: The first policy merge measures existing normalized coverage. A follow-up implementation closes required normalization gaps, then enables the hard gate.
